introduction--docs.content: import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; # Portfolio design system React components built from the Figma page **❖ Components** ([My-project](https://www.figma.com/design/bHRn6PCs8dDNpgPaYAnZ0p/My-project?node-id=1-57)). Each component has the same properties and default content as in Figma. The real page content lives only in the app. ## Sections - **Foundations**: colours, typography, spacing and radius. They're read straight from `src/tokens.css`, a 1:1 copy of the Figma variable collections and modes. - **Primitives**: Button, Link button, Icon, Logo. - **Layout**: Navigation, Footer. - **Sections**: Hero, Project card, About, Picture, Skill, Skills. Every component has a **Docs** page with its props (the Figma properties) and all its stories. ## Toolbar - **Theme**: Figma mode of `colour semantics` (light / dark). - **Frame**: Figma breakpoint mode (`>1280`, `>800`, `<800`) and frame width. Section stories set it themselves: Desktop 1280, Tablet 800, Mobile 375. The frame height hugs the content, like a Figma frame. ## Using a component ```tsx import { DsRoot, ProjectCard } from './components'; {/* sets the breakpoint mode from the window width */} {/* image slot, 16:9 */} ``` ## When Figma changes 1. Variables: update `src/tokens.css` (same names as Figma, `/` → `-`). Foundations update by themselves. 2. Text styles: update `src/typography.css`. 3. Components: update the matching folder in `src/components/`. Props keep the Figma property names.
